activity.notes: Representative span from departure of Magellan's expedition in Castilian service in 1519 to Magellan's death in 1521. The expedition's 1522 completion under Elcano is not attributed to Magellan's personal activity period.

sources.title: Ferdinand Magellan — Encyclopaedia Britannica
sources.citation_text: Britannica records Magellan's departure in 1519, his death in 1521, and the expedition's later completion under Juan Sebastián del Cano.
